grade_rationale: 15 P1 findings (3 spec-drift + 12 critical CVEs), 76 P2 findings, 0% domain spec coverage

escalations.title: proxy-addr — IPv4-mapped IPv6 IP Spoofing (AUTH BYPASS)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends IPv4-mapped IPv6 address to bypass IP-based access controls; any network user, zero-precondition
escalations.fix: npm update proxy-addr@^2.1.0 in all 4 affected packages
escalations.action: Security audit of all code paths relying on IP-based trust decisions

escalations.title: Handlebars.js — JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion (RCE)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker submits user-controlled template input → arbitrary code execution on the backend server
escalations.fix: npm update handlebars; audit whether backend renders user-controlled templates
escalations.action: Verify no user-controlled input reaches Handlebars renderer; remove usage if unused

escalations.title: protobuf.js — Code Injection via bytes Field Defaults
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker submits malicious protobuf message → code injection in orchestrator
escalations.action: Audit gRPC/protobuf message handling paths; check whether proto schemas accept external input

escalations.title: Tinypool — Prototype Pollution Gadget in Worker Options
escalations.exploit_scenario: Prototype pollution via worker options in test runner; potential RCE in CI/CD pipeline
escalations.action: Ensure CI/CD test environments are isolated; no external input should reach vitest worker options

findings.title: Verification gate is a false green — only scans Plans/, never Specifications/
findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to scan all Specifications/**/*.md; fail if any spec FRs have zero source references

findings.title: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md — 69 FRs completely unimplemented

findings.title: Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md — 10 FRs completely unimplemented
findings.recommendation: Governance decision: add STATUS: BACKLOG header or link to active Plan
